turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, and I'd like to know why my son's zero went into the gradebook before anyone called me.
I didn't ask for a thank-you. I asked who decided to enter that zero, and on what basis.
I'm waiting, Hale. Fifteen minutes of this room is not a lot, and I'd like an answer to the question I asked.
We're not here about the weather. Who decided, and on what basis?
I'm sorry, is that an answer? My client call is at 4:40, and I'll be in the principal's office after this if I don't get one.
